services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: Need a space for your business meeting, presentation, game night, book club, micro-wedding or get-together?Toronto's First Post Office offers space rentals at reasonable rates! Our main rental space is our Reading Room (photographed here) including access to our kitchen and washroom. Rentals can be booked during or after open hours. Please note that booking during open hours will not grant you exclusive access to the space as we are open to the public. For exclusive use, please book after visiting hours. services.name: Self-Guided Walking Tours
services.desc: Journey to the past, in person or virtually from the comfort of your own home, with our self-guided walking tour, "A Stroll through History." Tour through the original ten square city blocks that were instrumental in developing the Town of York and the stories behind some key contributing individuals. This complimentary tour can be enjoyed at your own pace and catered to your interests by choosing a few locations to visit or journeying through the entire tour.
